answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can submit work, then slash that stake if independent reviewers confirm fraud or duplicate identities. A newcomer can enter the haven, but cannot cheaply multiply influence: every fake identity needs its own locked capital, and detected copies lose it. The stake is a marble on the scale, not proof of honesty; a patient attacker may still profit, so the system must set the penalty above the expected gain and make appeals costly enough to deter a plume of disposable accounts.
